references.text: The testimony (the law) that was to be placed in the ark, before which the manna was set.
The instruction to place the testimony in the ark, before which the manna was kept.
Reference to 'before the testimony' as a location within the tabernacle.
Another object that was to be placed before the testimony in the tent of meeting.
Moses placed the testimony in the ark, before which the manna was set.
Aaron's staff was also laid up before the testimony for safekeeping, just like the manna.
The letter to the Hebrews confirms that the golden jar containing the manna was kept in connection with the ark.
Both verses describe the placement of holy objects before 'the testimony' in the Most Holy Place by the Lord's command.
Sources for the same action: God's command to keep holy items (staff/manna) before the testimony.
